title: SuperTag Objective manifest
description: A Objective manifest, as supertag apply -f reads it. Its spec is supertag.operator.v1.ObjectiveDeclaration in supertag/operator/v1/resource.proto; this file is generated from it.

name.description: The resource's name, unique within its kind.

ObjectiveDeclaration.description: The `spec` of an `Objective` manifest: standing work declared beside the Tags that do it. `metadata.name` is the Objective's ID. Owner, outcome, `ongoing`, Workspaces and which Team it names are fixed once it exists, and apply refuses a change to them. The deadline and runtime actions change, the budget only increases, and its own Team's fields change in place. A manifest that stops setting the budget, deadline or runtime actions leaves the stored value. A manifest has no `status`.

outcome.description: One natural-language statement: the result, how success is verified, what must not change, and when to ask a person.

ongoing.description: A continuing responsibility that only an operator can end.

workspaces.description: Names of existing Workspaces its work may use.

runtimeActions.description: Runtime actions, such as `files:write`, for turns admitted afterwards. A list narrows what the owner's Permission Sets allow. Omitted from a new Objective: what they allow when it is created.

team.description: The Team whose members the owner may hand work to. In a manifest it is one field, `team`: a Team's name, or the Objective's own Team.

oneOf.description: An existing Team, by name. Apply leaves it as it is.
The Objective's own Team, whose ID is the Objective's ID. Apply creates and updates it.

ObjectiveBudgetDeclaration.description: An Objective's budget as a manifest declares it.

minor.description: The limit in minor units of `currency`, or in allocation units without one.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 code, such as `USD`. With one, the budget caps provider-reported cost.

ObjectiveTeamDeclaration.description: An Objective's own Team as a manifest declares it.

name.description: The Team's name. Empty: the Objective's ID.

maxConcurrency.description: At most this many turns run at once across the Team's Objectives. Unset: only Worker Host capacity limits them.
